quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An international criminal syndicate operates across 40 countries with revenue exceeding many national GDPs.
quests.correctAnswer: Build a joint international task force with real-time intelligence sharing
quests.hint: Organisations operating across jurisdictions can only be defeated by law enforcement with equivalent reach and intelligence sharing.
quests.explanation: Real-time cross-border intelligence sharing is the operational requirement for defeating transnational criminal networks.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An international criminal syndicate operates across 40 countries with revenue exceeding many national GDPs.
quests.correctAnswer: Follow and disrupt the financial flows rather than just the physical network
quests.hint: Sophisticated criminal organisations are most vulnerable through their financial infrastructure — money laundering beneficial ownership.
quests.explanation: Financial disruption is more effective than physical enforcement against sophisticated transnational criminal organisations.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An international criminal syndicate operates across 40 countries with revenue exceeding many national GDPs.
quests.correctAnswer: Address the governance failures that allow criminal organisations to capture states
quests.hint: Where criminal syndicates capture national institutions external accountability pressure — sanctions monitoring — must substitute.
quests.explanation: Addressing state capture by criminal organisations requires both law enforcement and governance reform simultaneously.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Brain-computer interface technology is advancing faster than privacy and autonomy frameworks can address.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish neural data as a protected category requiring higher consent standards
quests.hint: Brain-computer interface data is categorically different from other biometric data and requires the highest consent standards.
quests.explanation: Neural data requires special legal protection because it reaches cognitive processes that no other data type can access.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Brain-computer interface technology is advancing faster than privacy and autonomy frameworks can address.
quests.correctAnswer: Create cognitive liberty rights in international human rights law
quests.hint: Mental privacy and cognitive autonomy must be explicitly protected as rights before neurotechnology makes them routinely violable.
quests.explanation: Proactive rights creation before widespread deployment prevents cognitive liberty from being commercially eroded.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Brain-computer interface technology is advancing faster than privacy and autonomy frameworks can address.
quests.correctAnswer: Require independent safety and ethics review before clinical deployment
quests.hint: Brain-computer interfaces require staged ethical review at each step from research to clinical to consumer deployment.
quests.explanation: Staged ethical review prevents the premature consumer deployment that outpaces safety understanding.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global water crisis is emerging as aquifer depletion threatens food security in multiple regions.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish binding international water accounting standards
quests.hint: Nations that extract shared aquifers must report extraction transparently — water accounting as rigorous as financial accounting.
quests.explanation: Transparent water accounting is the prerequisite for any effective governance of shared groundwater resources.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global water crisis is emerging as aquifer depletion threatens food security in multiple regions.
quests.correctAnswer: Reform agricultural water subsidies to reflect true scarcity costs
quests.hint: Water-intensive agriculture is heavily subsidised in most countries. Pricing reform is essential to curb unsustainable extraction.
quests.explanation: Water pricing reform in agriculture is the highest-leverage demand-side intervention for aquifer conservation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A global water crisis is emerging as aquifer depletion threatens food security in multiple regions.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest in water recycling and desalination infrastructure for water-scarce regions
quests.hint: Desalination and water recycling technology made affordable through international investment can supplement depleted aquifers.
quests.explanation: Supply-side water technology investment complements demand management to address scarcity comprehensively.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Surveillance capitalism is creating a global epistemic crisis through personalised reality distortion.
quests.correctAnswer: Ban micro-targeted political advertising based on behavioural data
quests.hint: Political advertising using behavioural manipulation data is categorically different from commercial advertising and must be prohibited.
quests.explanation: Banning behavioural micro-targeting in political advertising directly addresses the most damaging epistemic distortion mechanism.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Surveillance capitalism is creating a global epistemic crisis through personalised reality distortion.
quests.correctAnswer: Require platforms to offer chronological non-algorithmic feeds as default
quests.hint: Users must have a genuine choice between algorithmic and chronological information presentation.
quests.explanation: Default chronological feeds remove the engagement-maximising amplification that creates personalised reality bubbles.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Surveillance capitalism is creating a global epistemic crisis through personalised reality distortion.
quests.correctAnswer: Tax data extraction to fund public interest journalism and digital literacy
quests.hint: The economic model extracting value from attention should contribute to rebuilding the epistemic commons it has eroded.
quests.explanation: Data extraction taxes reinvest surveillance capitalism's revenue into the public goods that counteract its epistemic harm.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An armed non-state actor has seized control of a contested region and is committing atrocities.
quests.correctAnswer: Pursue a UN Security Council resolution authorising protective action
quests.hint: Any intervention requires multilateral legal authority — unilateral military action lacks legitimacy and creates further conflict.
quests.explanation: UN authorisation for protective action provides the legal basis and international burden-sharing that effective intervention requires.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An armed non-state actor has seized control of a contested region and is committing atrocities.
quests.correctAnswer: Prioritise protection corridors and humanitarian access in all negotiations
quests.hint: Every negotiation with the non-state actor must include humanitarian access as a non-negotiable minimum condition.
quests.explanation: Humanitarian access as a non-negotiable condition protects civilians when political resolution is distant.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An armed non-state actor has seized control of a contested region and is committing atrocities.
quests.correctAnswer: Engage regional organisations to lead the political track
quests.hint: Regional organisations with cultural and political knowledge should lead negotiations rather than distant international actors.
quests.explanation: Regional leadership in political negotiations brings cultural legitimacy that international actors cannot provide.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Deepening political polarisation is making democratic governance functionally impossible in a major democracy.
quests.correctAnswer: Invest in depolarisation mechanisms including electoral reform and citizens assemblies
quests.hint: Electoral reforms that reduce binary winner-take-all dynamics and deliberative processes that model civil disagreement both reduce polarisation.
quests.explanation: Structural electoral reforms address polarisation at the source — the incentive structures of winner-take-all systems.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Deepening political polarisation is making democratic governance functionally impossible in a major democracy.
quests.correctAnswer: Regulate social media platforms amplification of outrage content
quests.hint: Regulation must target the algorithmic amplification of outrage that makes political moderation politically costly.
quests.explanation: Regulating outrage amplification addresses the information environment that feeds polarisation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Deepening political polarisation is making democratic governance functionally impossible in a major democracy.
quests.correctAnswer: Fund cross-partisan civic infrastructure and shared public spaces
quests.hint: Shared civic institutions — public libraries community centres national service — create cross-partisan contact and relationship.
quests.explanation: Cross-partisan civic contact reduces the othering that makes political polarisation self-reinforcing.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A generational wealth gap is fuelling intergenerational conflict in multiple economies simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Reform inheritance and wealth transfer taxation to fund intergenerational equity
quests.hint: Excessive untaxed wealth transfer compounds inequality across generations. Tax reform can fund young people's opportunity.
quests.explanation: Intergenerational equity requires redistributive mechanisms that address accumulated wealth not just income.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A generational wealth gap is fuelling intergenerational conflict in multiple economies simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Prioritise affordable housing policy as the primary intergenerational equity issue
quests.hint: Housing affordability is the single most important factor in whether younger generations can build economic security.
quests.explanation: Housing policy is the most direct lever for addressing the asset-ownership dimension of intergenerational inequality.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A generational wealth gap is fuelling intergenerational conflict in multiple economies simultaneously.
quests.correctAnswer: Create youth representation in legislative and governance institutions
quests.hint: Youth quotas or youth chambers in legislative bodies ensure that future-oriented policy has structural representation.
quests.explanation: Structural youth representation creates the political incentive to address long-term intergenerational policy failures.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An existential risk from a newly discovered large asteroid is confirmed to be genuine.
quests.correctAnswer: Activate international space agency co-ordination immediately
quests.hint: NASA ESA JAXA and national agencies must pool all assets data and technical capacity immediately under unified command.
quests.explanation: Unified international command of technical assets is the prerequisite for an effective planetary defence response.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An existential risk from a newly discovered large asteroid is confirmed to be genuine.
quests.correctAnswer: Communicate the risk to the public with full honest transparency
quests.hint: The public must be told the truth. Managed communication of an extinction-level threat is both ethically required and practically necessary.
quests.explanation: Transparent public communication of existential risks enables the social co-operation that response requires.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An existential risk from a newly discovered large asteroid is confirmed to be genuine.
quests.correctAnswer: Allocate all available economic and scientific resources to deflection technology
quests.hint: Redirect global R&D resources toward kinetic impactors gravity tractors and related deflection technology immediately.
quests.explanation: Resource concentration on the highest-priority threat defines rational existential risk management.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An engineered pandemic with a 40 percent fatality rate has been confirmed in three continents.
quests.correctAnswer: Activate WHO emergency powers and mobilise all international health assets
quests.hint: Every WHO treaty obligation and international health regulation must be activated simultaneously with full national compliance.
quests.explanation: Full international health system activation from the first day of confirmed spread is essential to limiting an engineered pandemic.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An engineered pandemic with a 40 percent fatality rate has been confirmed in three continents.
quests.correctAnswer: Attribute the source and hold state and non-state actors accountable simultaneously
quests.hint: Attribution and containment must proceed simultaneously — accountability cannot wait for containment nor vice versa.
quests.explanation: Simultaneous attribution and containment is the only strategy that both limits the current pandemic and deters the next.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: An engineered pandemic with a 40 percent fatality rate has been confirmed in three continents.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish a war-time footing for global vaccine and treatment development
quests.hint: The accelerated development model — compressed timelines parallel development pre-commitment funding — must be globalised instantly.
quests.explanation: Globally co-ordinated accelerated medical countermeasure development is the fastest path from outbreak to protection.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Runaway artificial general intelligence represents a credible existential risk according to leading researchers.
quests.correctAnswer: Establish an international AGI development pause with verification
quests.hint: All nations developing frontier AI must implement a verified pause on systems above a defined capability threshold.
quests.explanation: A verified pause — not a voluntary one — is the minimum credible response to a confirmed existential capability risk.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Runaway artificial general intelligence represents a credible existential risk according to leading researchers.
quests.correctAnswer: Create mandatory interpretability requirements before frontier AI deployment
quests.hint: AI systems above defined capability thresholds must be interpretable — humans must understand what the system is doing and why.
quests.explanation: Interpretability requirements are the technical analogue to safety inspection — you cannot certify what you cannot understand.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Runaway artificial general intelligence represents a credible existential risk according to leading researchers.
quests.correctAnswer: Redirect the majority of frontier AI investment into safety research
quests.hint: If the capability-safety gap is the risk proportionate investment in closing it is the correct resource allocation.
quests.explanation: Resource allocation proportionate to the risk magnitude is the basic logic of rational existential risk management.
